St. Luke's Hospital &

Bombing outrage at
no.674 Wei Hai Wei Road
Medium Hotel (Chinese).

Further enquiries were made at the scene of the Bombing
by D.S.I. Tilton and D.S.I. T'ang Tzu Hung when the
injured accountant's personal effects were examined
which did not disclose anything of a suspicious nature
or to suggest that he may be concerned in political
activities.

Two small fragments of the bomb and a piece of wire
were brought to the station by the secretary of the
hotel, Lieu Kiang Fah ( 刘祥发 ) at about 10a.m. Sunday
Dec. 4, 1938. These will be forwarded to the Arms
Identification Section.

A visit was also made to the St. Luke's Hospital
at about 10.15a.m. Monday, Dec. 5 by the above detectives
where permission was obtained to briefly question the
injured accountant Zung Is Shun ( 陳志順 ). He stated
that he remembered the name on the parcel written in
Chinese pen as Van Ching Fun ( 范敬德 ). As regards
the opening/parcel he added that he had no special reason
for doing so at that particular time when the wedding
party was being held. He noticed the parcel in the
office and was of the opinion that he may be able to
gain information by opening it to be able to locate the

威海卫路674号
美琪饭店（中式）爆炸惨案。

探长蒂尔顿（Tilton）和探长唐子洪（T'ang Tzu Hung，音译）在爆炸现场进行了进一步调查，检查了受伤会计的私人物品，未发现任何可疑性质或表明其可能参与政治活动的迹象。

1938年12月4日（星期日）上午10时左右，饭店秘书刘祥发将两小块炸弹碎片和一段电线带到警局。这些物证将转交枪械鉴定科。

上述侦探还于12月5日（星期一）上午10时15分左右前往圣路加医院，获准简要讯问受伤会计陈志顺（Zung Is Shun）。他称记得包裹上用中文钢笔写的名字是范敬德（Van Ching Fun，音译）。关于打开包裹一事，他补充说，当时正在举行婚礼宴会，他并没有特别理由在那一特定时刻打开包裹。他在办公室里注意到了这个包裹，认为打开它或许能获取信息以找到

3rd. December, 38.

1.

7.48p.m. to 12m.n. No. 674 Wei Hai Wei Road.
Dec. 3, 1938.

Bombing outrage at
No. 674 Wei Hai Wei Road
Medium Hotel (Chinese).

At 7.48p.m., Saturday December 3 1938 a telephone
report was received from C.P.C. 2820 to the effect that
a bomb had exploded at the Medium Hotel, No. 674 Wei Hai
Wei Road causing injuries to two persons.

Chief Inspector Perkins with D.S.I. Tilton and D.S.I.
T'ang Tzu Hung attended and found an explosion had taken
place in the accountant's office situated on the 1st.
floor of the above address. The S.F. Brigade and
ambulance arrived at the same time and one seriously
injured employee named Zung Ts Shuh (鄭志大), age 28,
native of Ningpo, single accountant residing on the
premises together with an apprentice also employed and
residing at the hotel named Chang Far Ding (姜安庭),
age 15, native of Ningpo, were removed to the St. Luke's
Hospital, 219 Kiukiang Road.

The accountant was semi-conscious but unable to speak.
His injuries were later certified by Dr. C.S. Chien as
“(1) Compound fracture of left maxilla” (2) Compound
complex fracture of right forearm, radius and ulna (3)
Ruptured left eyeball (4) Laceration of left thigh and
genitalia. His condition is serious and detained.”

The apprentice's condition was certified by Dr.

1938年12月3日，晚上7时48分至午夜12时。威海卫路674号。

威海卫路674号
美琪饭店（中式）爆炸惨案。

1938年12月3日（星期六）晚上7时48分，接到中央电话交换台2820号的电话报告，称威海卫路674号美琪饭店发生炸弹爆炸，造成两人受伤。

警司珀金斯（Perkins）会同探长蒂尔顿和探长唐子洪赶赴现场，发现上述地址一楼的会计室发生了爆炸。救火队和救护车同时抵达，一名重伤雇员郑志大（Zung Ts Shuh），28岁，宁波人，单身，会计师，居住在该址，连同另一名也在饭店受雇并居住的学徒姜安庭（Chang Far Ding，音译），15岁，宁波人，被送往九江路219号圣路加医院。

该会计师处于半昏迷状态，无法说话。其伤势后经钱医生（Dr. C.S. Chien）证明为：“(1) 左上颌骨复合性骨折” (2) 右前臂桡骨和尺骨复合复杂性骨折 (3) 左眼球破裂 (4) 左大腿及生殖器撕裂伤。病情严重，留院观察。”

同一位医生证明为“前额擦伤”。病情不严重。该学徒未留院治疗。
爆炸发生房间的状况清楚地表明，爆炸威力巨大，毁坏了室内的家具，并将书籍和纸张炸成碎片。两扇窗户的玻璃被炸落到下面的街道上。会计的办公桌上被炸出一个洞，椅子也被毁坏。
调查显示，大约在1938年11月12日，住在饭店内的9号衣帽间侍应生张文成（Tsang Yung Zung）回忆收到一个用棕色纸包裹、绳子捆扎的包裹。包裹内似乎装有一本厚书，尺寸约为12英寸乘6英寸乘6英寸。包裹是寄给某人的，姓名已无法回忆，由一名骑自行车的未知苦力送到饭店。该苦力没有留下任何口信，只是将包裹交给衣帽间侍应生。侍应生没有询问苦力，因为他认为包裹是给饭店客人的，直到后来经过查询，他才发现并没有这样的客人住在店内。随后他将包裹交给了会计室。会计随即将其放在桌边，等待日后可能的认领者。

pages.en:
Misc. No. 509/38.

1/sheet 3.

The matter was also known by the hotel's secretary
named Lieu Ziang Fah ( 刘祥芬 ). A further witness
the aforementioned apprentice stated that at about 7.40
p.m. above date he was in the accountant's office and
observed him remove the parcel from near the window and
place it on his desk. The accountant was sitting at his
desk at the time and commenced to unfasten the string
while the apprentice watched. At this time a guest
called the apprentice to telephone for a hire car and as
the latter was doing so in the accountant's office at a
wall telephone near the door, an explosion suddenly took
place. The room became full of fumes and smoke. The
apprentice ran out of the office and noticed the account-
ant lying below the desk.

A further visit was made by D.S.I. T'ang to the
hospital in order to learn of the address on the parcel
however this was found impossible as the accountant's
condition is critical.

The manager of the hotel named Mr. Sze Yung Ling
( 史永龄 ), age 41, native of Ningpo, residing at No. 35
Pah Sih Fong ( 八仙坊 ) Rue Krastser F.C. was question-
ed at B'Well Station. He stated the hotel was opened in
September 1938 and was formerly the Medium Club which was
opened in 1933. The members at that time were mostly
Chinese bankers and other influential persons.
pages.zh:
杂项案号：509/38。

第1页，共3页。

饭店秘书刘祥芬（Lieu Ziang Fah，音译）也知晓此事。另一位证人，即前述学徒陈述称，在上述日期晚上7时40分左右，他在会计室，看到会计将包裹从窗边拿走并放在他的办公桌上。当时会计正坐在办公桌前，开始解开绳子，学徒在一旁观看。此时，一位客人叫学徒去打电话叫一辆出租车，当后者在会计室靠近门口的墙式电话旁打电话时，突然发生了爆炸。房间里充满了烟雾和烟气。学徒跑出办公室，注意到会计躺在桌子下面。

探长唐再次前往医院，试图了解包裹上的地址，但由于会计师病情危重，发现这不可能做到。

饭店经理史永龄（Sze Yung Ling）先生，41岁，宁波人，居住在法租界辣斐德路（Rue Krastser）八仙坊35号，在毕威尔巡捕房接受讯问。他称该饭店于1938年9月开业，前身是美琪俱乐部，该俱乐部于1933年开业。当时的会员大多是中国银行家和其他有影响力的人物。

pages.en:
Misc. No. 509/38.

1/sheet 4.

The manager at that time was the secretary of the
club. He firmly denied knowing of any reason as regards
a motive in leaving the bomb at the hotel. He could not
recall, or his secretary, any person residing recently at
the hotel who could be suspected of being connected with
any political party.

At the time of the explosion in the office a wedding
party was in progress in adjoining main dining hall where
about 130 Chinese guests had assembled and were enjoying
the wedding feast. The explosion resulted in a panic and
they all fled hurriedly from the scene. No injuries were
reported. The bridegroom Mr. Sih Hyoch Yien ( 薛鈺敏 )
age 20 years, native of Wusih, residing at No. 1021 Sinsa
Road and his bride Tsu Lee Nung ( 朱麗敏 ), age 17, native
of Soochow were both questioned at the station. They
denied knowing the accountant earlier and first met him
concerning the wedding arrangements about 2 weeks ago.
They both denied knowing of any reasons to suggest that
the bomb was left to cause harm to them and the guests.

Mr. Sih is the editor of a small mosquito paper
named "Sih Pao" ( 錫報 ) office at 446 Hankow Road.
He stated that his paper is confined to all articles of
local interest and avoids all news of political signifi-
cance This paper was formerly printed and sold in Wusih
and the business was transferred to Shanghai since

= I. 8149. C 194
D 5604/6
pages.zh:
杂项案号：509/38。

第1页，共4页。

当时的经理是该俱乐部的秘书。他坚决否认知道任何关于在饭店放置炸弹的动机。他或其秘书均无法回忆起最近住在饭店的任何可能与任何政党有关联的可疑人员。

办公室发生爆炸时，相邻的主餐厅正在举行婚礼宴会，约有130名中国客人聚集在一起享用婚宴。爆炸导致恐慌，众人匆忙逃离现场。据报道无人受伤。新郎薛鈺敏（Sih Hyoch Yien，音译），20岁，无锡人，居住在新闸路1021号；新娘朱麗敏（Tsu Lee Nung，音译），17岁，苏州人，均在警局接受讯问。他们否认此前认识该会计师，大约两周前因安排婚礼事宜才首次与他见面。两人都否认知道有任何理由表明放置炸弹是为了伤害他们和客人。

薛先生是一家名为《锡报》（Sih Pao）的小型八卦小报的编辑，报社位于汉口路446号。他称其报纸仅限于刊登所有本地兴趣的文章，避免刊登任何具有政治意义的新闻。该报以前在无锡印刷和销售，自

= I. 8149. C 194
D 5604/6

pages.en:
Misc. No. 509/38.

1/sheet 5.

August 1937. He denied having any trouble formerly
concerning the issue of the paper, or threatening letters.
Statements are attached taken from three witnesses
as mentioned in this report.
A careful search made at the scene of the explosion
and debris by detectives under the supervision of the
D.O. "B" Mr. Yorke and D.D.O. "B" Mr. Crouch resulted in
17 pieces of tin fragments of the bomb being found, also
two small lead and wire connections, a piece of string,
and a cell of a dry battery of "Central Battery Factory"
make, bound with black adhesive engineer's tape. A
small length of wire is attached to the end of the cell
bound by the tape.
The pieces of bomb will be forwarded to the Arms
Identification Section for examination.
It appeared that the force of the explosion was
spread mainly in two directions, upwards to the ceiling
and down through the accountant's desk.
Uniform Police are posted at the scene pending
further investigation.
D.O. "B", D.D.O. "B", and Senior Detective attended.
D.C. (Mvs.), D.C. (Special Branch) and C.S informed.
D.S. McKeown who was informed, attended.
(Copies of report to:- D.C. (Mvs.), D.O. (Sp.Branch),
and C.S.
Enquiries by D.S.I. Hillen, D.S.I. Tiong Tze Heng &
C.D.O. Ng.

Sen. Det.
（签名）

A.G. Allen.
D. S. I.
pages.zh:
杂项案号：509/38。

第1页，共5页。

1937年8月以来业务转移至上海。他否认以前在发行报纸方面遇到过任何麻烦或收到过恐吓信。
本报告提到的三位证人的供词附后。
在“B”区警务督察约克（Yorke）先生和“B”区副警务督察克劳奇（Crouch）先生的监督下，侦探对爆炸现场和碎片进行了仔细搜索，结果发现了17块炸弹锡片碎片，还有两个小的铅线和电线连接件、一段绳子，以及一节“中央电池厂”制造的干电池，用黑色粘性电工胶带捆绑。电池末端连着一小段电线，也用胶带捆绑。
炸弹碎片将送交枪械鉴定科进行检查。
看来爆炸的威力主要向两个方向扩散，向上冲向天花板，向下穿过会计的办公桌。
在进一步调查期间，现场已部署制服警察警戒。
“B”区警务督察、“B”区副警务督察和高级探员到场。
已通知机动队副督察长（D.C. (Mvs.)）、特务处副督察长（D.C. (Special Branch)）和首席书记官（C.S）。
已通知并到场的还有副探长麦基翁（McKeown）。
（报告副本分送：- 机动队副督察长、特务处警务督察、以及首席书记官。
由探长希伦（Hillen）、探长钟子恒（Tiong Tze Heng，音译）及华人侦探主管吴（Ng）进行调查。

高级探员
（签名）

A.G. Allen.
探长。

Tsang Vung Zung (張文城), age 19,
Ningpo                                      C. D. C. 278 Wong Nyeh Ping
                                            translated
B'Well Stn.          3/12/38                xxxxxx       Clerk P'eng.

States:-

    My name is Tsang Vung Zung, age 19, native of Ningpo,
employed and resided at No. 674 Weihaiwei Road, Medium Hotel
as cloak room boy No.9, for 3 years.
    At about 10a.m. 3 weeks ago, when I was on duty,
a messenger wearing short jacket and pants and riding a bicycle
came to the hotel and delivered a small brown paper parcel to
a guest whose name I cannot remember now. After he handed over
the parcel, he went away. I took the parcel to rooms upstairs
but as there was no such a person, I handed it over to an
accountant named Zung Ts Shuh (鄭志旭) (the injured man)
for safe custody. This was witnessed by a secretary named
Lieu Ziang Fah (刘祥芬). At about 7p.m. to-night, when
I was on duty in the cloak room, I heard a round of an explosion
but as I was very busy at that time I paid no attention to it.
About 4 or 5 minutes later, a guest came to the cloak room to
get his clothing and told me that a bomb had exploded upstairs,
and as a number of guests approached and wanted to have their
clothing back, I locked the room door and proceeded upstairs
to request the accountant's instructions. When I approached
the door of the accountant's office, I saw the accountant lying
on the floor and his body was bloody. Police later arrived
and sent the injured man by ambulance to hospital.

    The above is my true statement.

                                Signed & cross-examined by
                                    Tsang Vung Zung.

张文城（Tsang Vung Zung），19岁，
宁波                                      中央侦探社 278 黄业平（Wong Nyeh Ping，音译）
                                            翻译
毕威尔巡捕房          1938年12月3日                xxxxxx       书记员 彭（P'eng）。

陈述如下：-

    我叫张文城，19岁，宁波人，在威海卫路674号美琪饭店担任9号衣帽间侍应生，受雇并居住于此已3年。
    大约三周前的上午10时，当我值班时，一名身穿短夹克和裤子、骑着自行车的信差来到饭店，将一个棕色小纸包交给一位客人，其姓名我现在已记不起来。他交出包裹后就离开了。我把包裹拿到楼上的房间，但因为查无此人，我便将其交给一名名叫郑志旭（Zung Ts Shuh，音译）（伤者）的会计代为保管。此事由一名名叫刘祥芬（Lieu Ziang Fah，音译）的秘书见证。今晚大约7时，当我在衣帽间值班时，听到一声爆炸响，但当时我非常忙碌，所以没有在意。大约4或5分钟后，一位客人来到衣帽间取衣服，告诉我楼上发生了炸弹爆炸，由于许多客人前来想要取回衣物，我锁上房门，上楼请示会计。当我走近会计室门口时，我看到会计躺在地板上，浑身是血。警察随后赶到，用救护车将伤者送往医院。

    以上是我的真实陈述。

                                签署并经盘问
                                    张文城。

Chang Eur Ding ( 姜安庭 ), age 15.
Ningpo                                  C.D.C.278 Wong Mych Fing
B'Well Stn.          3/12/38            translated      Clerk P'eng.
                                        xxxxxxx

States:-

      My name is Chang Eur Ding, age 15, native of Ningpo,
residing No. 674 Weihaiwei Road Medium Hotel where I have been
employed as an apprentice for over a year.
      At about 7.30p.m. 3/12/38 I saw the accountant named
Zung Ts Shuh ( 鄭志旭 ), age 25, native of Ningpo try to
unfasten a parcel wrapped by brown paper and tied with a
string.   The parcel was placed on the desk and I was standing
by the side to watch it.   In a moment a Chinese male guest
called me to telephone for a hire car and I then proceeded to
the wall which was 5' away from the desk to turn the figures
of a telephone for the Chiao Tung Garage and while I was doing
so I heard an explosion and an offensive odor irritating my
nose.   The room became full of fumes and smoke.   I immediately
ran out of the accountant's office.   Later an ambulance arrived
and conveyed me and the accountant to hospital.   I do not
know anything else.
            The above is my true statement.

                        Signed & crossmarked by:-
                                Chang Eur Ding.

姜安庭（Chang Eur Ding），15岁。
宁波                                  C.D.C.278 Wong Mych Fing
贝勒路巡捕房          1938年12月3日            翻译      彭书记员。
                                        xxxxxxx

陈述如下：

      我叫姜安庭，15岁，宁波人，居住在威海卫路674号中社（Medium Hotel），我在那里当学徒已有一年多。
      1938年12月3日晚上7点30分左右，我看见一名名叫郑志旭（Zung Ts Shuh）的会计，25岁，宁波人，试图解开一个用牛皮纸包裹并用绳子捆扎的包裹。包裹放在桌子上，我站在旁边观看。过了一会儿，一位中国男客人叫我去打电话叫一辆出租车，于是我走到离桌子5英尺远的墙边，去拨交通大学汽车行（Chiao Tung Garage）的电话号码，就在我这样做的时候，我听到一声爆炸，并闻到一股刺激鼻子的难闻气味。房间里顿时充满了烟雾和毒气。我立刻跑出了会计办公室。后来一辆救护车赶到，将我和会计送往医院。其他情况我一概不知。
            以上是我的真实陈述。

                                姜安庭。

Standard and other local newspapers: 4-12-38 (PM)

PARCEL EXPLODES IN A CLUB

At 8.10 p.m. yesterday an explosion took place in the accountant's office of the Medium Club (中社), No.674 Weihaiwei Road, as a result of which an accountant named Zung Ts-shioh (郑志旭), aged 28, native of Ningpo, and an apprentice named Chiang An-ting (姜安定), aged 15, native of Ningpo, were injured.
Enquiries made by our reporter show that about three weeks ago a yellow paper parcel was delivered by a cyclist to the accountant's office of the Medium Club with a request that it be handed to a certain person living in the dormitory. The parcel was taken up by a room boy to the room indicated by the sender but as nobody answering to this description could be found the boy returned with the intention of handing it back to the cyclist but the messenger had already left. The parcel was then left in the accountant's office to wait for a claimant.
At 8.10 p.m. yesterday the accountant Zung Ts-shioh opened the parcel to ascertain its contents when an explosion occurred injuring him in the head and right hand while the apprentice Chiang An-ting was also hurt. The injured men were removed to St. Luke's hospital. The apprentice was discharged as his injuries were not serious, while the accountant is in a critical condition due to loss of much blood.
The Police are conducting an investigation into the affair.

《标准报》及其他本地报纸：1938年12月4日（下午）

俱乐部内包裹爆炸

昨晚8点10分，威海卫路674号中社（Medium Club）会计室发生爆炸，导致一名名叫郑志旭（Zung Ts-shioh）的会计，28岁，宁波人，以及一名名叫姜安定（Chiang An-ting）的学徒，15岁，宁波人受伤。
本报记者经查询获悉，约三周前，一名骑自行车的人将一个黄色纸包裹送到中社会计室，要求将其转交给住在宿舍里的某个人。一名茶房将包裹送至寄件人指定的房间，但因找不到符合描述的人，茶房便返回，打算将包裹交还给骑车人，但信使已经离开。随后该包裹被留在会计室，等待认领。
昨晚8点10分，会计郑志旭打开包裹以查看内容物时发生爆炸，致其头部和右手受伤，学徒姜安定也受伤。伤者被送往圣路加医院（St. Luke's hospital）。学徒因伤势不重已出院，而会计因失血过多，情况危急。
警方正在对此事进行调查。
